title: Is There a Lifetime Toll Pass? What the FASTag Annual Pass Really Covers
seoTitle: Lifetime Toll Pass? FASTag Annual Pass Facts 2026
seoDescription: No lifetime toll pass exists. The FASTag Annual Pass costs ₹3,075 for 1 year or 200 trips at NH toll plazas. Rules, eligibility and how to buy.
excerpt: Explains the FASTag annual toll pass and the proposed lifetime pass, how they work with the FASTag you already have, and how they compare with today's monthly single-plaza pass for regular highway users.
